## Research Interests

3-manifolds, essential and measured laminations, taut foliations, pseudo-Anosov flows, hyperbolic geometry, knot theory, Teichmüller theory, essential surfaces, normal and almost-normal surfaces, and ergodic theory.

## Education

**University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign**, Champaign, Illinois, 2021–present. PhD in Mathematics, expected May 2027. Advisor: Nathan Dunfield.

**Brigham Young University**, Provo, Utah, 2017–2020. BS in Mathematics.

## Research Appointment

**SLMath Program Associate**, Berkeley, California, March 16–April 24, 2026. Participant in [*Topological and Geometric Structures in Low Dimensions*](https://www.slmath.org/programs/368).

## Publications and Preprints

**Brevan Ellefsen.** *Growth Rate of Essential Surfaces via Measured Laminations*. 2026. [arXiv:2608.08833](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08833) [math.GT].

## Research in Progress

**Least-Weight Laminations.** Developing a normal-surface theory of least-weight representatives of essential measured laminations.

**Volume Bounds on Growth.** Investigating bounds on measured-lamination-space dimension, and hence essential-surface growth, in terms of hyperbolic volume.

**Minimal Laminations.** Studying when essential laminations admit representatives whose leaves are minimal for a suitable ambient metric.

Further details, including ongoing extensions of the surface-counting results, are on my [research page](research.qmd).
